Annehmen or Aufnehmen? German B1 Prefix Verb Practice

Compare annehmen for accepting and aufnehmen for recording or admitting in German. Learn contextual prefix meanings with translated examples and answers.

B1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Understand the difference

Annehmen can mean accepting an offer or invitation. Aufnehmen can mean recording sound or admitting someone to a group. Both have further meanings, so learn whole combinations: eine Einladung annehmen, ein Gespräch aufnehmen, ein Mitglied aufnehmen. Their separable prefixes appear at the clause end in main statements.

Common mistake to avoid

Annehmen also means assuming in some contexts; aufnehmen also has uses beyond recording. The requested meaning and noun partner decide these exercises.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1Ich nehme die Einladung zum Workshop gern an.I gladly accept the invitation to the workshop.
Worked example 2Wir nehmen das Lied im Studio auf.We record the song in the studio.
Worked example 3Sie nimmt das Angebot nach kurzer Überlegung an.She accepts the offer after brief consideration.
Worked example 4Der Chor nimmt im Herbst neue Mitglieder auf.The choir admits new members in autumn.

Practice: choose the right word

Choose annehmen for accepting the specified offer or aufnehmen for recording/admitting. Use the infinitive. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Question 1. Die angebotene Stelle möchte sie ___. (accept)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: annehmen

Eine Stelle annehmen means accepting the offered job.

Question 2. Das Interview möchten wir mit Zustimmung aller Beteiligten ___. (record)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: aufnehmen

Ein Interview aufnehmen means making a recording.

Question 3. Die Einladung kann ich diesmal nicht ___. (accept)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: annehmen

Eine Einladung annehmen is accepting an invitation.

Question 4. Der Verein möchte weitere Mitglieder ___. (admit)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: aufnehmen

Mitglieder aufnehmen means admitting them to the association.

Revise it so it sticks

Return to this lesson tomorrow and complete the four gaps without looking at the rule. Then write two of your own sentences using today's pattern. Check whether the subject, case and verb position match the explanation.
